description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.7, §2.12): Brannock's marchwarden, who keeps the town and the March's roads. At stage 4 or less she meets the giant inside the south gate; a bigger giant she meets on the giants' green outside it (the director moves her: the town's POI has max_inner_stage 4). Protected: every blow is refused (still an offence).
